merit.scale_policy: declared by decimal type; excess-scale literals rejected
merit.rounding_policy: half_even attached to nominal decimal type
merit.range_policy: AccountNumber and Sequence are language bounded types; balance maximum is an explicit business rule
merit.representation_boundary: canonical financial values; COBOL physical encoding handled separately by merit-copybook

java.precision_policy: application literals and business checks; BigDecimal itself is arbitrary precision
java.scale_policy: application-created scale-bearing literals; BigDecimal permits values with differing scales
java.rounding_policy: no rounding occurs in this add/subtract workload; operations requiring rounding must select policy explicitly
java.range_policy: primitive long identifiers/sequences plus application business checks
java.overflow_policy: BigDecimal arithmetic is arbitrary precision; business maximum enforced by application comparison
java.representation_boundary: canonical financial values; legacy physical encoding requires a separate adapter
